title: Use of Non-Invasive Positive Pressure Ventilation in Patients With Severe Obesity Undergoing Upper Endoscopy Procedures
brief_summary: The study evaluated the effect of non-invasive positive pressure ventilation (NIPPV) to decrease the incidence of desaturation events in patients with severe obesity undergoing upper endoscopy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Weight loss surgery patients undergoing preoperative upper endoscopy
* BMI 40-60

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant patients
* Previous weight loss surgery or stomach surgery
* BMI \> 60 and BMI \< 40
* Active smokers
* Patients with a history of recent URTI (Upper Respiratory Tract Infection) within the preceding 2 weeks
* Lung disease, COPD asthma, cystic fibrosis, sarcoidosis
* Baseline O2 saturation less than or equal to 94%
* Exclude substance abusers (active alcohol abuse, benzodiazepine abuse, and active illicit drug use)
